review.publication: Local database and working tree only; do not push or deploy.
review.scope: Core IT foundations: types versus values, character/string senses and notation, addresses, and processing activities.
review.context_policy: Keep existing home contexts. IT assertions use U3; mathematical real/rational/integer values also retain an explicit U1 path. U2 remains empty.
review.new_concept_budget_review: Raise the pilot estimate from 25 to 33: two type/value splits and six missing shared concepts are necessary for the selected distinctions. This is a revised estimate, not a target to exhaust.
review.limits: No general type-to-value membership rule is introduced. Exact bit-width/range properties, void conventions, code points/code units/graphemes, ambiguous Map/heap, and the other mixed data-structure children need separate review. String length counts positions in the selected character sequence, not bytes or display width. No application tests, commits, pushes, or deployments are part of this batch.

concepts.name: беззнаковый целочисленный тип данных
concepts.reason: An integer type representing nonnegative values without a signed interpretation. Width and range depend on the specific type. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/winprog/windows-data-types

concepts.name: символьный тип данных
concepts.reason: A type for character representations. The unit and encoding are language-specific; one char need not represent one Unicode abstract character. Source: https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-4.html

concepts.name: строковый тип данных
concepts.reason: A type whose values are strings. Distinct from a particular sequence and from its substring. Source: https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html

concepts.name: длина строки в символах
concepts.reason: The number of positions in the selected character sequence, including zero; not byte length, physical length, or number of distinct symbols. Source: https://xlinux.nist.gov/dads/HTML/string.html

concepts.name: адрес (вычислительная техника)
concepts.reason: A value designating a location in a computer address space, with numeric or symbolic forms. The addressed storage is distinct from its address. Source: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/3.1.0?topic=testauth-address-expression

concepts.name: обработка данных
concepts.reason: Computational processing of input data. Algorithms, processing models, and executions are different concepts. Source: https://nightlies.apache.org/flink/flink-docs-stable/docs/learn-flink/overview/

concepts.name: сопоставление строки с регулярным выражением
concepts.reason: The activity of checking a string against a regular-expression pattern, including whole-string and substring matching modes. Source: https://docs.python.org/3/library/re.html

concepts.name: рациональное число
concepts.reason: A real number expressible as a ratio of two integers with a nonzero denominator. Integers are included. Source: https://openstax.org/books/college-algebra-2e/pages/1-1-real-numbers-algebra-essentials
